newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - University of Central Florida.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - University of Central Florida.

text.p: Sealed bids will be received in the office of the Division of Bond Finance at the address given below up to such date and time as may be determined by the Director of the Division of Bond Finance and communicated through MUNIFACTS NEWS SERVICE not less than 20 hours prior to the time bids are to be opened.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Bond Sale and the Bid form may be obtained, when available, from the Director, Division of Bond Finance, 1801 Hermitage Boulevard, Suite 200, Tallahassee, Florida 32308, telephone (904) 488-4782.
*Preliminary, subject to change as provided in the Notice of Bond Sale.
